title: 第1章 实习系统和没梦想的主角第2章 打工是不可能打工的
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 【恭喜宿主即将转生，我是您的专属修仙系统，现在开始随机天赋属性。】
一道带着AI配音味道的声音响起，让还在恍惚的郑常回过神来。
看着周围泛着白光的世界，郑常明白了过来。
“哦！我死了啊！”
【请宿主开始随机天赋属性。】
系统的声音再次响起，让郑常皱起眉头。
眼前出现的写着“随机抽取”半透明图标，郑常想了想，按了下去。
眼前出现一个巨大的转盘，并开始旋转起来。
随后一道蓝光闪过。
【宿主抽取结果如下】
【风灵根（A级），中等单灵根，修行速度较快，对风灵气亲和度高。速度成长中等程度增加。】
【身强力壮（C级），基本体质属性，比常人稍强的体质，炼体成长轻微程度增加。】
【十八般兵器（B级），普通武器精通，擅长各种兵器，武器修行熟练普通程度增加。】
【博闻强识（A级），中等悟性属性，学习能力强，术法、功法、修仙百艺熟练度成长中等程度增加。】
【福星高照（S级），高等运气属性，运气极好，发现机缘概率较高程度增加。】
【长得还行（C级），基本魅力属性，相貌比普通略微高一点，他人好感度加成速度轻微程度增加。】
【寂寂无名（D级），下等名望属性，路人一个，无名望属性加成。】
一共获得了七个天赋，除了运气，都很普通。
【抽取结束，天赋最高等级SSS，最低E级，E级为负面天赋，最多可获得十个天赋，宿主是否重新抽取？】
看着眼前【是】和【否】两个图标。
郑常想了想，按下了【否】。
【正在为宿主重新随……嗯？？？】
系统毫无波澜的语气被打破了，她好像听错了？
不行，再问一次……
【宿主是否重新抽取？】
“否。”郑常开口道。
【天赋最高等级SSS，目前宿主抽取天赋较为……】
“好了，就这样吧。”郑常不耐烦道。
系统脑子里飞速思考。
不对啊！和前辈们说的不一样啊！不是说穿越者都要刷初始号的吗？
有些强迫症，几个月啥也不干，玩了命刷天赋，不刷10个SSS天赋就不出发了。
自己这第一个宿主怎么不走寻常路啊？自己这实习工作不会出问题吧？实习证明还拿不拿得到了？
“喂，选好了，什么时候开始啊？要是不能穿越，赶紧把孟婆汤什么的给我喝了好去投胎吧。”郑常不耐烦道。
系统最后一眼看了看这穿越者的信息，这人不是叫郑常吗？怎么这么不正常？
【宿主是否确认以目前天赋穿越进修仙界？】
“是！是！是！我选是再不出发差评了。”
系统吓了一跳，“差评”二字触发了她的PTSD，她吓得启动了穿越程序。
【穿越开始！】
只是马上，系统便后悔了，自己的宿主以这样的天赋穿越到修仙界，自己的实习项目还能结业吗？
一道白光，闪过。
实习系统和没梦想的主角。一同消失在了这片空间。
content_en:
[Congratulations to the host who is about to be reincarnated. I am your exclusive immortal cultivation system. Now I will start randomizing talent attributes. 】
A voice with the sound of AI dubbing sounded, bringing Zheng Chang, who was still in a trance, back to his senses.
Looking at the world glowing with white light around him, Zheng Chang understood.
"Oh! I'm dead!"
[Please host to start randomizing talent attributes. 】
The sound of the system sounded again, making Zheng Chang frown.
A translucent icon with the words "Random Draw" appeared in front of him. Zheng Chang thought about it and pressed it.
A huge turntable appeared in front of me and began to spin.
Then a blue light flashed.
[The host extraction results are as follows]
[Wind Spirit Root (Level A), a medium single spiritual root, with fast cultivation speed and high affinity for wind spirit energy. Speed ​​growth moderately increased. 】
[Strong body (C level), basic physical attributes, slightly stronger than ordinary people, physical growth slightly increased. 】
[Eighteen Weapons (Level B), proficient in ordinary weapons, good at various weapons, weapons proficiency increased to ordinary level. 】
[Extensive knowledge and strong knowledge (level A), medium comprehension attribute, strong learning ability, moderate increase in proficiency in spells, exercises, and the various arts of cultivating immortals. 】
[Lucky star shines brightly (S level), high luck attributes, excellent luck, higher probability of finding opportunities. 】
[Alright looking (Grade C), basic charm attribute, slightly taller than average in appearance, and the speed of increasing others' favorability is slightly increased. 】
[Silent and Nameless (Level D), low-level reputation attribute, one passerby, no reputation attribute bonus. 】
A total of seven talents were obtained, and apart from luck, they were all ordinary.
[The extraction is over. The highest talent level is SSS and the lowest is E level. E level is a negative talent. Up to ten talents can be obtained. Does the host draw again? 】
Look at the two icons [Yes] and [No] in front of you.
Zheng Chang thought for a while and pressed [No].
[Re-accompanying the host...huh? ? ? 】
The system's calm tone was broken. She seemed to have heard wrongly?
No, ask again...
[Does the host need to be re-extracted? 】
"No." Zheng Chang said.
[The highest level of talent is SSS. Currently, the host’s talent extraction is relatively...]
"Okay, that's it." Zheng Chang said impatiently.
The system's mind was thinking rapidly.
That’s not right! It’s different from what the seniors said! Doesn’t it mean that all those who travel through time need to get an initial number?
I have some obsessive-compulsive disorder. I do nothing for a few months. I play with life and gain talents. I won’t start until I gain 10 SSS talents.
Why didn't my first host take the usual path? There won't be any problems with your internship, right? Have you got your internship certificate yet?
"Hey, you've made your choice, when will it start? If you can't travel through time, give me some Meng Po soup or something so I can reincarnate." Zheng Chang said impatiently.
The system took one last look at the traveler's information. Isn't this person named Zheng Chang? Why is this so abnormal?
[Has the host confirmed to travel to the immortal world with his current talent? 】
"Yes! Yes! Yes! I choose not to post negative reviews again."
The system was shocked. The word "bad review" triggered her PTSD, and she was so frightened that she started the time-travel program.
【The time travel begins! 】
But immediately, the system regretted it. His host traveled to the world of immortality with such talent. Can he still graduate from his internship project?
A white light flashed.
The internship system and the protagonist who has no dreams. They disappeared into this space together.
